// The Studio

Small studio, serious shipping

PsyCodes Studio is a software and game development studio founded in 2026 in Karachi, Pakistan. We build across three crafts — games, apps and the web — with one rule: if it isn't playable, usable and scalable, it isn't done.

Because we're small, you talk directly to the people building your project. No account managers, no hand-offs — just regular builds you can try and feedback that lands in the next update.

Founder — Bilawal Feroze

Founded by Bilawal Feroze

PsyCodes Studio was founded in 2026 with a simple banner promise — Code. Create. Automate. — and a focus on shipping real products: FitLyfe, Hot Cocoa Run, and client work across games, web and mobile.

// FAQ

Before you ask

It depends on scope: a landing page can take one to two weeks, a typical business website or game prototype two to six weeks, and a full mobile app or game longer. When we reply to your order, you get a realistic timeline for your specific project before you commit to anything.

Every project is quoted individually after we understand the scope — you send the form, we reply with a clear scope, timeline and a fixed quote. There's no cost and no obligation to ask, and we won't start paid work until you've approved the quote.

Yes. If your idea needs confidentiality, we're happy to sign an NDA before you share sensitive details. Your concepts, code and data stay yours.

Just the order form: what you want to build, who it's for, and anything it must do. Rough ideas are fine — part of our job is turning “something like this…” into a concrete scope. If you have examples, sketches or an existing brand, sharing them helps but isn't required.

Often, yes — choose “Other” in the service dropdown and describe what exists today. We'll review it and honestly tell you whether improving it or rebuilding makes more sense.
